name: Career Survival: risk-first career ladder
instruction: Load the career-survival skill once and follow it for one 48-month game. Read the public handbook once and create exactly one game; reuse its session_id. Before every decision observe, then take_action with one offered integer choice and a one-sentence English note. Keep only the compact memory the skill describes; do not use the code tool. Survival overrides growth: risk warnings, low Health, Dignity, Network or Wealth, and weak reviews come first. Do not assume hidden thresholds. On a timeout, observe and check recent logs before retrying. Continue until an explicit ending_score, print it in full, then print DONE.
